title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions made by the model.

title: Identify True Positives
text: A true positive is when the model predicts a $$1$$ and the actual value is also $$1$$. Count the number of true positives in the given data.

title: Identify False Positives
text: A false positive is when the model predicts a $$1$$ but the actual value is $$0$$. Count the number of false positives in the given data.

title: Calculate Precision
text: Use the formula for precision: $$precision=true$$ positives/(true $$positives+false$$ positives).
